label: Order
caption: DAVID WOOD V. RACHEL PATTON, ASSISTANT ATTORNEY GENERAL
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, and the response filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that in light of the stay of execution granted by the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals on March 11, 2025 (case No. WR-45,746-04), the application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Alito is denied as moot.
